blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Laguna First District Rep. Ann Matibag on Saturday, Sept. 19, said her office will welcome any evidence of anomalous projects against her district if there were any, after Davao City Rep. Paolo “Pulong” Duterte claimed to have documented videos. “If Congressman Duterte has documents or videos showing possible irregularities in projects in my districts, he should submit them, together with the specific project details, to the proper authorities,” she stated in a statement.
